reason: Both plans meet every hard requirement equally well, but Response A sequences data integrity verification (step 9) before repointing application traffic (step 10), so the cutover only proceeds once source and target are confirmed to match — Response B repoints traffic and restarts app services (step 9) before running verification (step 10), which is riskier ordering even though maintenance mode still gates end-user exposure. Response A also ties its rollback trigger explicitly to the preceding steps and backup, making the runbook slightly more precise and safer to execute.
